d:
Tyohar aate hi khane-pine ki chizon ki dimand bhi barhti hai. lekin isi tyohari sizan men milavti khane-pine ki chizen bhi bazaron men bari matra men pahunchti hai.
Kuchh pakri jati hain, lekin kuchh logon ke gharon tak pahunch jati hai. magar milavti mithaee, khoya ya koee bhi dusra khane ka saman sehat par lanbe vakt men ganbhir asar chhor jata hai.
Halanki, kuchh aise tarike hain jisse aap ye pata laga sakte hain ki kahin koee milavti phud aaitam aapke ghar to nahin pahunch gaya hai.
Riport: shubhangi mishra
Shut: mahroz
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
